page.title: Tools
page.subtitle: Descriptions/bindings for system tools, plus custom tools (command/script/http)

system.title: System tools
system.descMatching: {matched} / {total} matching; click a card to edit the description, parameter defaults and agent bindings
system.descTotal: {total} total; click a card to edit the description, parameter defaults and agent bindings
system.empty: (no system tools yet, waiting for the backend seed)

custom.title: Custom tools
custom.descMatching: shell/command/script/http, {matched} / {total} matching; click a card to edit
custom.descTotal: shell (bash declaration) / command (command template) / script (Python) / http (API), {total} total; click a card to edit
custom.empty: (no custom tools yet; click 'Create custom tool' in the top right)

editor.sheetDescription: Edit the description, parameter defaults and agent bindings
editor.trafficGated: This tool depends on traffic capture. Enable traffic capture under "System settings" first before binding it to agents and enabling it.
editor.bindAgents: Bind agents (controls which agents get this tool)
editor.paramsLabel: Parameters (name / type / required are read-only; description and default are editable)

dialog.description: shell = a bash environment declaration (name + description only, telling the model bash is available); command/script/http need an execution spec.
dialog.shellHint: Suited to well-known tools like nmap, sqlmap, ffuf — the model already knows their usage; you only need to declare "can be invoked in bash". The name + description are appended to the Bash tool's description.

script.bodyLabel: Python body (params arrive via stdin JSON / os.environ["TOOL_X"])

schema.labelHttp: Parameter JSON Schema (required for http tools, must include properties)
schema.labelAuto: Parameter JSON Schema (empty = a thin '{args}' shell is generated automatically)

dialog.deferred: deferred (enable only for many rarely-used tools)

test.label: Test run (uses the current form, nothing is saved)

toasts.invalidKey: key must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters/digits/underscores
toasts.httpNeedsSchema: http tools must provide a parameter JSON Schema (with properties; cannot be empty)
